shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --branch
git log -3 --oneline
rg -n -C 8 "runs onError and afterSession when it throws|beforeSession|Measured semantics|Installing hooks|validated by" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG*'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,70p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts
git show --stat --oneline HEAD~1..HEAD"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check
git diff -- specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
git status --short'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m "docs: link beforeSession hook test"'
